description: Add support for generating thumbnails from WebP image files. The system should use the official Go WebP decoder to process WebP images and create thumbnails in PNG format. If thumbnail generation fails for any reason, the system should gracefully fall back to using the original full-size image as the thumbnail.
functional_requirements: Implement WebP image decoding using the official Go WebP package to read WebP files
Generate thumbnails from WebP images in PNG format since the current imaging library doesn't support WebP output
Maintain the existing fallback behavior where failed thumbnail generation uses the original full-size image
Ensure the thumbnail generation process handles potential decoder errors gracefully without crashing
Update the file processing logic to recognize and properly handle WebP files alongside existing image formats
